# Mathematics Foundations — Course Outline

**Faculty:** Faculty of Science  
**Path id:** `sci-mathematics`  
**Tier:** foundation · **Annual school fees:** APW$ 450 (dual tender)  
**Audience:** Senior High

## Description

Strengthen algebra, functions, and quantitative reasoning used across STEM.

## Objectives

- Build Senior High competence aligned to the faculty mission.
- Complete each lesson card with a written practice response.
- Be ready to discuss ideas aloud in class mode.

## Lesson sequence

| # | Lesson | File |
|---|--------|------|
| 1 | Linear Relations | `lessons/01-linear-relations.md` |
| 2 | Equations and Systems | `lessons/02-equations-systems.md` |
| 3 | Functions and Graphs | `lessons/03-functions-graphs.md` |
| 4 | Exponents and Growth | `lessons/04-exponents-growth.md` |
| 5 | Problem-Solving Lab | `lessons/05-problem-solving-lab.md` |

## Assessment (v1)

Opening a lesson card and engaging the practice prompt counts as progress. Formal exams are out of scope for this content pack version.
